text: Felwood Flyover Reverse: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Felwood Flyover Reverse.
Felwood Flyover: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Felwood Flyover.
Felwood Flyover: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Felwood Flyover.
Felwood Flyover: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Felwood Flyover.
Felwood Flyover Challenge: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Felwood Flyover Challenge.
Felwood Flyover Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Felwood Flyover Challenge.
Felwood Flyover Reverse Challenge: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Kalimdor Felwood Flyover Reverse Challenge.
Felwood Flyover Reverse Challenge: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Kalimdor Felwood Flyover Reverse Challenge.
Felwood Flyover Reverse Challenge: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Kalimdor Felwood Flyover Reverse Challenge.

The Fetid Pool is a sickly green lake located in the hills near Legion Hold in western Shadowmoon Valley. It is populated by fleshbeasts and is the site of a broken fel reaver. Adventurers come here in search of the reaver's power core, which lies at the bottom of the pool.
A Festival Loremaster can be found in: *Teldrassil *Stormwind City *Ironforge *The Exodar *Shattrath City
This item can be purchased for from in any major city, or in Moonglade.

Ferra Leafheart is a Highmountain tauren sitting in a hut slightly northwest of the lower level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. She is having a conversation with Gala Woodbridge, A'te Amberfur and Mora Cliffhoof about their children.
Ferocity of the Ferocity Path is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Jaws of the Mongoose trait.

The ferry map is the user interface accessed from ferry masters to show the available ferry paths to travel throughout Tiragarde Sound of Kul Tiras. This feature is only available to the Alliance. The user interface uses a modified version of the Flight Map, which instead of flight points, it uses the ferry points.
Fiddlesticks is a crawling hand located on Darkmoon Island. He is the drummer of the Blight Boar.
Fezzix's Flying Machine is a flying machine located in the Borean Tundra. Fezzix Geartwist is trying to fix it up.

Find Minerals is a starting ability of the primary profession Mining which shows nearby mineral veins and deposits as gold veins () on the mini-map. When you mouse-over the gold dots, it will reveal what type of ore the vein will yield. Note that this skill shows ALL mineral veins, regardless of the Miners ability to actually mine them or not. Bright gold veins indicate that the vein is on the surface. Dull gold veins indicate that the vein is underground in a cave or dungeon, unless you are also underground, in which case they will show as bright gold.

Find Herbs is a starting ability of the primary profession Herbalism which shows nearby herbs as gold herbs () on the mini-map. If you mouse-over the dot on the mini-map if will show what type of herb you will be able to receive. Note that all herb clumps are shown, regardless of the Herbalist's ability to actualy harvest it or not. If the dot is grey, it means the herb is growing underground in a cave or dungeon.
Filled Shimmering Vessel was created after using Shimmering Vessel on Blood Elf Magisters, in Silvermoon City.
Fight-or-Flight Amplifiers are sold for by Fitzi Gearwobble and Goldo Fizzcrackle during Island Expeditions.

Fire Power is a mage talent talent that increases damage done by fire spells by 1% per rank, up to 3% at max rank 3. This is a multiplicative talent that is applied after the addition of spell damage item bonuses, and is multiplied together with similar talents, buffs and vulnerabilities.

Fire Plume Ridge is the volcano in the center of Un'Goro Crater. Lava flows down the sides of the mountain, where fire elementals can be found. The strongest of all fire elementals in Un'Goro, Blazerunner, lives within a cave at its peak. The fiery mountain forms a natural border where the jungle meets the earth, scorched from lava flows. Shallow veins of magma flow beneath the bowl of the crater, heating the steam pools and geysers around Un'Goro. The hottest place in the ridge is apparently 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit. Ringo came to the ridge to explore and ended up getting lost and now suffers from heat exhaustion, he can be found in the southern cave. After the Fourth War, Zekhan reporte

The Fire Totem is required for a shaman to use fire-aligned totems. If no Fire Totem is in your inventory, you cannot use fire-aligned totems. All relic slot totems count as Fire Totems, and if one is equipped or in the shaman's inventory, the Fire Totem item is not needed. The Fire Totem can never be destroyed, however once the shaman reaches level 40, he can undertake the Relic of the Earthen Ring (alliance version) quest to combine the Fire Totem with the other three elemental totems to create the Totem of the Earthen Ring which takes one inventory space instead of four. The Totem of the Earthen Ring can be equipped as a relic or destroyed if desired.

Fire Festival Fortitude is a buff gained when a player of the same faction completes one of the following quests: *Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame *Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame *Stealing the Undercity's Flame *Stealing Silvermoon's Flame *Stealing Darnassus's Flame *Stealing Ironforge's Flame *Stealing Stormwind's Flame *Stealing the Exodar's Flame

Fire Powered is one of the four buffs necessary to earn the feat of strength . Engulfed scales with level and will deal the player's numeric level in damage every three seconds. Despite the tooltip, it only stacks three times, not five.
Fire-Eater's Vial is awarded to players who complete the Darkmoon Racer Roadhog achievement, awarded for completing The Real Race in 11 tolls at the Darkmoon Faire.

Finja, the Flying Star is a murloc martial artist active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone. He appears to be the result of the Jade Lotus' efforts of turning murlocs into "finjas".
Fire and the Flames is a Destruction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Chaotic Instability and Demonic Durability traits.

__NOTOC__ Firewing Warlocks are blood elves found at Firewing Point in Terokkar Forest. They stand around magical obelisks and runed circles and are found channeling magic energies into the Mana Bomb.
Firemane Drake can be found flying over Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Fireworks Instruction Manual teaches hunters the Fireworks (hunter ability) ability.

First Mate Swainbeak is a giant talking parrot who accompanies Captain Stef "Marrow" Quin at the Redsilt Wash in Vol'dun. It cannot aggro onto a player separately from Quin, and will only enter combat when Stef does. When Stef is killed, Swainbeak will fly off and despawn. Swainbeak can also be summoned by wearing Marrow's Sash and having Salty Dog Crackers in your bag to briefly accompany the player.

The First Ones (also known as the Progenitors) are enigmatic godlike beings who shaped the cosmos and the fabric of all realities. They conceived and put in place the six governing forces of reality—Light, Void, Order, Disorder, Life, and Death—as well as the pantheons that embody them—such as the Pantheon of Order and Pantheon of Death—and the realms that they inhabit. The First Ones are shrouded in mystery, and very little is known for certain about them: it is unknown when they first walked the cosmos, whether they still do, or if their existence ended ages ago. The First Ones' magic and architecture are so advanced that they resemble mathematics, and are characterized by geometric fracta
The Fist of Cenarius is a two-handed mace that gives a bonus to magical power and chance to critical hit with spells.
Fish or Cut Bait: Undercity is an achievement gained by doing the fishing dailies in Undercity. It is a criterion of the achievement Gone Fishin'.

The Fist of Garrosh was a planned name for the gunship that the Horde used during the attack on Theramore to carry the mana bomb that leveled the city to the ground. Its captain was intended to be Sky-Reaver Stormhowl. In the released material, the mana bomb was carried by a goblin zeppelin. It was also planned to be the gunship flying from Durotar to the Jade Forest before being replaced.

Flagellation is the rogue class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all rogues who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.
Five of Air is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Dance. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Dance trinket.
Five of Earth is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Watcher. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Watcher trinket.
Five of Fire is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Inferno. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Inferno trinket.
Five of Frost is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Rime. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Rime trinket.

Flametongues are a race of dragonspawn. Although these dragonspawn are technically advanced members of the wyrmkin race, the flametongues' abilities and capacities are superior enough that they can be considered a different species. A wyrmkin is elevated to flametongue status by showing consistent skill and leadership. The dragon mentor performs a ritual that emulates a dragon's own transition from drake to mature. The flametongue is then taught spells and new abilities — and is also trained to break out of the shell of the disciplined, unquestioning wyrmkin to become an independent thinker and strategist. Flametongues carry swords and/or spears as well as shields. Weapons and/or armor are m
The Flame of the Undercity is obtained when an Alliance character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in Undercity.
__NOTOC__ Flameshockers were burning skeletons attacking the Undercity and Stormwind City during the Scourge Invasions.

.]] Flame Leviathan is the first boss encounter in Ulduar, found in the Formation Grounds. Most of the players in this encounter do not use their regular class abilities, but instead use vehicles (similar to drakes in Malygos' third phase). The rest of Ulduar is not accessible until this boss is destroyed.

Flamegates are portals to areas within the Firelands. There are a number of these scattered around Mount Hyjal. It is possible that these gates are made by Cindermaul. The gates lead to: ; The Firelands Hatchery. : Introduced via The Hatchery Must Burn, the Firelands Hatchery is a cavern filled with eggs. The character is required to defeat Twilight's Hammer cultists while flying on a hippogryph and wielding a lance. Eventually, the character destroys eggs that were stolen from Aviana and corrupted. ; The Firelands Forgeworks. : Introduced via Into the Maw!, the character enters and dispatches Forgemaster Pyrendius among other nasties. ; The Crucible of Flame. : Introduced via The Third Flam
Flames of Xoroth is a Destruction warlock ability available at level 79. It is named after Xoroth, a world of the nathrezim (who are famous for using demonic magic to revive the dead.)

Flaskataur is a tauren that appears on the PTR and beta realms to aid players. He originally appeared in the patch 2.1 PTR, handing out lots of cool flasks to help people test the new raid content with the appropriate levels of gear. He also gave out lots of epic gear to every character. He sold the following, Flaskataur exclusive, goods and other stuff like Potions and Ammo: *Flaskataur's Celestial Brew *Flaskataur's Tears *Flaskataur's Flask of Flaskocity *Flaskataur's Flask of Pretty Good Power At some point, he could be summoned using the Flaskataur's Lamp. A female Flaskataur has also been spotted.

This item is created with Alchemy, requiring a minimum skill of 425. (Note that it requires Alchemy skill of 400 to be used.) The recipe for this item is learned from grand master alchemy trainers. As of 3.3 this flask gives either a Spellpower or Strength buff to druids, meaning you have to click it twice and/or mouse over the buff to make sure you got the one you want. There is currently no widely known way to always get one or the other with either an addon or a macro.
__NOTOC__ A Flask of Titanic Strength increases strength by 300 for an hour.
The Flaskataur's Flask of Pretty Good Power was sold by the Flaskataur during the PTR testing of the Black Temple. It functioned similarly to the Flask of Supreme Power.
Flayedwing Harriers are flayedwings flying around over the Shattered Span in Bastion.

Fleshcraft is the signature ability of the Necrolord Covenant, available to all Necrolord members. This ability is also temporarily available during the Maldraxxus portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Blade of the Primus and lasts until you finish the Maldraxxus storyline.

Flayed Shot is the hunter class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all hunters who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.

__NOTOC__ Flik is a wandering orc child frog vendor located in the Darkmoon Faire camp, which is only available during the monthly Darkmoon Faire event. He may be hard to catch as he is quite small and runs around inside and outside the faire.

A flight path (often abbreviated as FP) is the primary means of zone-to-zone travel on Azeroth and Outland. They are a transportation link between two fixed geographical points via fixed paths on faction-exclusive aerial mounts. The Alliance utilizes both the gryphons of the Hinterlands and the hippogryphs of Kalimdor for transportation, while the Horde uses Kalimdor's wyverns, Lordaeron's massive vampire bats, and Quel'Thalas's rare dragonhawks. See the side bar for links to listings of specific flight paths.
Flok is an orc flight master located at The Sludgewerks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Flock is an ability used by chickens, turkeys and other flying pets during a Pet Battle.

The Flourishing Protector is an ancient protector located in Felwood. He sprouted from the ground as a Seedling Protector when an adventurer poured a vial of moonwell water on the hill between the three ancients in Irontree Woods. The adventurer helped the seedling to find rich soil and food, and it grew into a Sapling Protector. The protector then asked the adventurer to help him find sunlight to bask in, and to destroy the sickened treants in the area. This freed the treants' spirits from their rotting bodies and allowed the protector to house them safely together within his own body. After he became the Flourishing Protector, there was one more task before he set his roots: He asked the a
Flight Master's Whistle is a quest reward from Uniting the Isles and Uniting the Isles (alt). It summons the Flight Master's Mount.
Flight Mechanics are gnomish engineers that are at the Ironforge Airfield and Kharanos during the Legion Invasions. They are working on maintaining gyrocopters and flying machines for the battle.
__NOTOC__ Flightmaster Volnath is a nightborne located in Nighthold. As a flight master-like mob, he can summon Regal Cloudwings.
__NOTOC__ Flightgineer Krazzle is a goblin located in the Arathi Highlands. He also participates in the Battle for Stromgarde. He owns a flying machine.
The Flight Master's Mount comes in various races and is summoned by Flight Master's Whistle.
Flight Master Nudolva is an aranakk flight master located at Spider's Watch in Maldraxxus.
FlowerPawa is a lynx located in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City, standing next to Madelia Bruder.
Flight School Graduate is a quest achievement earned by completing all of the Flight School World Quests in Bastion listed below.
Flickerwick Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.
__NOTOC__ Flitterfly is a faerie located in Shimmerbough in Ardenweald. Nuuminuuru wishes for Flitterfly to return to Glitterfall Basin.

Fletcher Nisekh is a centaur located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He is one of the few surviving members of Clan Toghus, having been rescued from the village of Daruukhan after it was destroyed by Clan Nokhud. After he is rescued by Taivan and the player returns to Marukaai, he and the rest of the Toghus survivors can be found near the center of the city, being tended to for their injuries.

The Flight Master's Report is found at on a barrel beside the Obsidian Rest flight master Keskos in northern Zaralek Cavern. Ebyssian is looking for it in The Obsidian Rest, part of the Embers of Neltharion campaign. It reads:

The Flying Sheep On Fire can be found on The Dungeons of Dalaran map. Kael'thas and Vashj activated a secret level by stepping on platforms to say, "Bah-Ram-Ewe". These were marked off by special sheep, the Blood Sheep, Inner Sheep and Cold Sheep, in that order from bottom to top. A door then opened, leading to a circle of Flying Sheep on Fire, which activated the secret level called The Crossing.
Focused Rage is a 30-point Warrior Protection-tree talent that reduces the Rage cost of all offensive abilities. It reduces the Rage cost of abilities by 1 Rage per talent point, to a maximum of 3.
The Flying Carpet is a flying carpet mount which can be crafted by tailors.

, a footbomb field.]] Footbomb was a goblin sport usually played on Kezan. In the game, goblins sit in shredders and kick footbombs onto the opponents' shredders to destroy them (which may or may not be part of the normal game). Then, they need to kick a footbomb into the opponents' goal. The last Footbomb match was played by a goblin adventurer, who kicked the footbomb into Mount Kajaro, during the exact moment when Deathwing caused the mountain to erupt. The Coin-Operated Crowd Pummeler can summon Azerite Footbombs.

This is a guide to collecting Coins of Ancestry for those with the Flight Master's License. It covers all Elders found in Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, including those in dungeons and capital cities. For Northrend Elders, see Flying Guide to Northrend Lunar Festival Elders.
Flyby is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Flying Tiger Gourami is a quest available from the Flying Tiger Gourami, which is randomly caught from freshwater in Pandaria.

__NOTOC__ Flying Snow is a pandaren warrior of the Shado-Pan encountered during the beginning of Master Snowdrift's encounter in the Shado-Pan Monastery. She wields two blades in battle and has a Bladestorm-like ability called Whirling Steel. She is apparently one of Snowdrift's best students.

Focus and Harmony is a passive ability for Mistweaver Monks that is learned at level 45. Unlike the other Monk specs, Mistweavers have a 1.5sec GCD which through this ability can be lowered to 1 sec with Haste.

Follower Ability Retraining Manual is available from Sergeant Crowler at Lunarfall and Sergeant Grimjaw at Frostwall for . It also has a chance of being looted from Follower Retraining Scroll Case (rewarded from the garrison mission Lessons of the Blade). It was briefly rewarded from Relic Hunter: Gronnsbane, Relic Hunter: Silent Skull, and Wanted: Gor'thul.

This is a guide to collecting Coins of Ancestry for those with Cold Weather Flying. It covers all Elders found in Northrend, including those in dungeons and capital cities. For Azeroth Elders, see Flying Guide to Lunar Festival Elders.
__NOTOC__ Folla Sternhoof is a Highmountain tauren innkeeper found at Spiritwatch Point in Highmountain.
The Folded Blight Boar Poster was to be obtained through the Blight Boar event on Darkmoon Island. The ID of this item was instead reused for Torn Pieces of a Blight Boar Poster.
Flying Brawler is a Pet Battle achievement earned for winning PvP pet battles through find battle with a full team of level 25 flying pets.

The Focused Star Point is a quest reward from Restored Hope. Only classes with a healer specialization can receive it. For characters who chose the Death-Resistant Leaf when completing Restored Hope, this item can be purchased for 10 Corrupted Mementos from Zhang Ku at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 1 of the Spirit of Preservation Essence and leave behind Star Powder.
Flying tomes are magically animated tomes, books enhanced to act on their own.

Fodder to the Flame is the demon hunter class ability of the Necrolord Covenant. It's available to all demon hunters who join the Necrolords. This ability is also temporarily available during the Maldraxxus portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Champion the Cause and lasts until you finish the Maldraxxus storyline.
Fly-Eyed Eliera is an aranakk flight master located at Keres' Rest in Maldraxxus.
Flying Festivities is a feat of strength achievement earned for obtaining the Wreath-A-Rang from the Winter Veil Gift of 2020.
__NOTOC__ Flying Fiends are gargoyles flying between the Reliquary of Pain and Voltarus in Zul'Drak.
Flyspawn Mandibles drop from Flyspawn Beetles in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Flyspawn Thorax drops from Flyspawn Beetles in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Flyspawn Chitin drops from Flyspawn Beetles in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ Flying Fish Bone Charm is an Iskaaran Fishing Gear Material. It is created with 1 Flying Fish Bones.
Flying Battler of the Dragon Isles is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the elite pets and trainers of the Dragon Isles with a team of all level 25 Flying pets.
Flying Squirrels are flying squirrels located in the Scaleborn Pass in the Forbidden Reach.
Flying Battler of Zaralek Cavern is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the pet trainers of Zaralek Cavern with a team of all level 25 Flying pets.
Forceful Deflection is a passive death knight ability that increases the parry rating in proportion to 25% of the death knight's strength.
Forlorn Ridge is a mountain that was once located in southwestern Azshara. When the Bilgewater goblins settled the region, they moved the entire mountain north.

Forge sites (split into camps and bases) are the places used by the Burning Legion for the construction of its mechanical units such as fel reavers. They are populated by some form of gan'arg engineer and mo'arg forgefiend, and often overseen by a more powerful demon. An example of this is Forge Camp: Fear in Nagrand, which has gan'arg, mo'arg and is overseen by Xirkos, Overseer of Fear, a powerful annihilan.

, the titan-forged stronghold housing the Forge of Origination.]] The Forge of Origination is a powerful titan-forged device that was crafted by Archaedas and Mimiron and installed in the jungles of Uldum by Highkeeper Ra and his followers during the ordering of Azeroth. The Forge of Origination would serve a dual purpose: it would regulate the rhythms of the earth and fortify the world-soul's form, but if the planet became corrupted, the Forge would eradicate all life in the world, allowing it to start anew. Its twin, the Forge of Wills, was constructed in Ulduar with a different but complementary purpose.

The Forever Tree is a tree that magically grew during the Cataclysm from the corpse of the young dryad Taryndrella in a valley under the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp in the Stonetalon Mountains when Aramar Thorne buried her there. One year after her death, Aramar and his friends reunited at the Forever Tree to commemorate her and vowed to meet again next year. Aram also buried one shard of the Diamond Blade here. According to the base's soldiers, the tree blooms year-round.

The Forgotten Feather is located at on a floating island southeast of the Keeper's Respite in northeastern Korthia. To get to the island, use a Goblin Glider Kit or Slow Fall from at the path immediately to the south of the respite. Loot the feather for the Forgotten Feather item and progress toward Treasures of Korthia.

Forged Ranseur is looted from a Weapons Rack on the second floor of a building in Tranquillien in the Ghostlands. It is taken to be empowered by magic from Bastion and Maldraxxus in the Shadowlands, and both Fightlord San and Vandellor infuse it with enhancements against Vorath.
The Formula: Smoking Heart of the Mountain is an Enchanting (265) formula that teaches you how to craft the Smoking Heart of the Mountain.
The Formula: Enchant Ring - Healing Power was sold by Almaador in Shattrath City.

Formula: Enchant Gloves - Mining is sold by Dark Iron Entrepreneur in Arathi Highlands in unlimited quantity for . This item dropped from the following Dark Iron dwarves in Wetlands prior to Cataclysm: *Dark Iron Dwarf *Dark Iron Demolitionist *Dark Iron Tunneler *Dark Iron Saboteur *Balgaras the Foul These enemies can be found in Dun Modr and at the three camps along the northern mountain range, southwest of Dun Modr. Balgaras is in the eastmost camp along the mountains (not in Dun Modr).
Formula: Enchant Cloak - PvP Power teaches PvP Power (enchant).
The Formula: Enchant Ring - Stats was a reputation reward; you had to be with Lower City to purchase it for from: * in Shattrath City * in Tanaris

Forsaken Assassins were level 29 - 30 Forsaken that could be found in Ashenvale. They were able to use a "perfect" version of the ability Stealth. While using this ability they could not be discovered by any means.

Forsaken Infiltrators were level 29 - 30 Forsaken that could be found in Ashenvale. They were able to use a "perfect" version of the ability Stealth. While using this ability they could not be discovered by any means.
Forsaken Dark Stalkers are Forsaken found in Ashenvale. They are able to use a "perfect" version of the ability Stealth. While using this ability, they could not be discovered by any means.

Forsaken Intruders were level 28 - 29 Forsaken that could be found in Ashenvale. They were able to use a "perfect" version of the ability Stealth. While using this ability they could not be discovered by any means.
Forsaken Infantry are part of the main ground forces occupying both Emberstone Village in northeastern Gilneas and Gilneas City during The Battle for Gilneas City.
Formula: Magic Lamp teaches an enchanter how to create a Magic Lamp companion pet.
Formula: Enchant Gloves - Mighty Strength teaches an enchanter Mighty Strength.
Formula: Enchant Bracer - Major Strength teaches Major Strength (bracers enchant).

Forsaken Castaways are the survivors of the capsized fleet that was docked along Duskmist Shore before tidal waves from the Cataclysm destroyed them. They are now descending upon the Hayward Fishery in Gilneas en masse, much to the dismay of the Hayward brothers. The brothers are attempting to escape the invasion and devastation by sea, but are being thwarted in their efforts by the castaways.

Formula: Enchant Chest - Sustained Strength teaches Enchant Chest - Sustained Strength. At Renown level 8 with the Maruuk Centaur, it can be purchased for from Quartermaster Huseng in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

The Foxflower is an herb found around Highmountain on the Broken Isles. It's named after its similar appearance to a fox's tail. They have small, nearly invisible scent glands that give off a smell that is both completely disgusting and strangely alluring. Foxflowers can be turned into powerful fluxes, mostly used to help weld leystone.
Four of Frost is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Rime. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Rime trinket.
Four of Fire is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Inferno. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Inferno trinket.
Four of Earth is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Watcher. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Watcher trinket.
Four of Air is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Dance. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Dance trinket.

Frayed Abomination Stitchings are magically enhanced thread used to hold together Abominations. Prior to the Cataclysm (see Patch 4.0.3a), they were used as an ingredient in numerous quests for rare and valuable magic items.
Fozruk is a mountain giant found in the Arathi Highlands. An ally of Thenan and the Drywhisker kobolds, Fozruk carries the magical rod which unlocks the Keystone in the Circle of Inner Binding.
Francis Greene is the flight master located on an atoll at Sandy Beach in the contested territory of Shimmering Expanse. He works as a connection with the underwater flight masters of Vashj'ir.

Frag is a deceased earth elemental lying on an island in the middle of a small lake in the Bloodhunt Highland in Highmountain. It was the youngest and perhaps most dear of three small guardians created by Navarrogg, who sends the player to rescue his creations during Pet Rocks. Upon approaching and attempting to recover Frag's body, Torok Bloodtotem will say the following: :
Fredo the Patron is a Highmountain tauren food and drink vendor found at the Summitcrest Basecamp in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Francis Serbacon is a Forsaken located in the Magic Quarter in Undercity. He claims to be the author of the Steamy Romance Novel series.
Frankie Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

__NOTOC__ Frezza is a goblin zeppelin master located in the zeppelin tower on the Orgrimmar Skyway. He gives information about Undercity, and the safety of the Zeppelin service to and from there. Of course, he then follows this safety notice with a prohibition on smoking and fire magic while on the ship.

Fresh Holly can be used while riding a mount and will transform your mount into a reindeer until you dismount. Flying mounts can still fly, and will lift off with a jingly bell sound, leaving an energy / snowflake trail. Fresh holly requires Feast of Winter Veil, meaning it will only work during the event.

, a pirate frigate.]] Frigates are intermediary warships, very similar to destroyers, to the point that in The Frozen Throne the filename for the frigates' icons denoted them as destroyers. It is unknown why the name was changed.

__NOTOC__ The Frenzied Black Drake is a black drake spawned when a player talks to Cyrus Therepentous in the Burning Steppes during the quest A Taste of Flame (2). This quest requires a player to obtain a Black Dragonflight Molt which can either be obtained through Hoard of the Black Dragonflight (container) received at the end of the Divine Retribution questline or by slaying and looting the Frenzied Black Drake.

Freshly Dug Dirt was found on the southernmost island (the second one, beyond the metal framework) of Tanaris. The two islands in this area were not found on the map of Tanaris or the world map, but you will appear near the bottom edge of the world map below Kalimdor. To get there you will need a certain buff, or to corpse hop. Swimming speed modifiers (like potions and equipment) do not stack with this buff. It is involved in the following quests: *Draconic for Dummies (quest) *rAnS0m

Frightened Mountainstriders are moose found wandering around Thunder Totem in Highmountain. They ran away from Liza Galestride's stable when the "kerfluffle with the drogbar" happened, so Liza asks players to round the young moose up and return them to her stable.

Heathens also have a place in the Zandalar tribe, and are known as freethinkers among the Zandalari. Freethinkers do not fear oppression and die for what they believe in. Battle gear gives one power in the tribe. The freethinkers are honored in this way. They are zealots and imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo. If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not. Ancient Zandalari were branded as heretics when the Gurubashi Empire was strong. Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar, but were hunted and killed as vermin. Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God and so the tribe honors the price the freethinkers paid.

__NOTOC__ Frightened Gilnean Child is a human child found in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus during the Burning of Teldrassil. She was saved by Genn Greymane who took her into the portal to Stormwind City.
Fresh Star Moss is looted from Star Moss in Kul Tiras and Zuldazar.

Frost Channeling is a mage talent that reduces the mage's spells mana cost by 5% per rank and Frost spells' threat caused by 3-4% per rank, up to 10% mana reduction and 10% threat reduction at max rank 3. This talent is primarily taken by PvE raiding frost mages. The mana reduction helps with long boss fights, allowing the mage to favor spell power gear, sacrificing overall mana. The threat reduction allows the mage to safely do more damage. Similar threat reduction talents include Burning Soul (mage ability) which reduces threat from Fire spells by 10% at max rank, and Arcane Subtlety, which reduces threat from Arcane spells by 40% at max rank. .]] :Death knights personify the frigid invulnerability of Icecrown. Frost Presence is the baseline death knight DPS Presence. It increases Runic Power generation by 20% and reduces the duration of crowd control effects on the death knight by 20%.
Frostbrood Slayer is a frost wyrm found in the realm of shadows during The Power to Destroy. It cannot be attacked and seemingly serves no purpose.

__NOTOC__ Frostbrood Spawn are frost wyrms located at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising. Occasionally, they take a Wyrm Reanimator into their mouth and fly away.

Frost Wyrm Egg is a usable item obtained as a random zone drop in Ashran. It summons a large Frostwyrm, which will fly down the Road of Glory toward the enemy base, using its Deep Breath ability to freeze enemy players beneath it as it passes. For more information and tips on use within Ashran, see Ashran#Frost Wyrm Egg.

Frost Worms are bait items that can be fished up from open water in Highmountain or from Highmountain Salmon Schools, with an increased chance to be caught while using the Arcane Lure. They can also be purchased from Akule Riverhorn for . The worm enables one to catch Coldriver Carp. If this item is used after having obtained the Underlight Angler, one will instead be able to catch Coldriver Carp.

Frostwhisper Gorge is a canyon in southern Winterspring, just north of Darkwhisper Gorge. It is scattered with night elven ruins both at the bottom of the gorge and at the ridges above. A great bridge to Darkwhisper Gorge spanned across the chasm until the Shattering destroyed it. Several of the huge Frostmaul Preservers and Frostmaul Giants reside here, as well as Ice Avatars led by Frostilicus.

__NOTOC__ The Frostwing Halls is an area inside Icecrown Citadel where all the Frostbrood Dragonflight appear in. It is also the prison of Valithria Dreamwalker. The Frostwing Halls opened on February 2, 2010, two weeks after the opening of the Crimson Hall and two months after the opening of the Citadel. During the war against the Lich King, adventurers came here to destroy Sindragosa, leaving only her skull behind. However, rather than leave her to suffer again in some form, they took her crystalline essence to Kalecgos at Wyrmrest Temple, where she could truly be laid to rest.

Frostfire Orb is a Mage talent in the Frost tree, affecting Frostfire Bolt and Flame Orb. It gives the Flame Orb frost powers, transforming it into a "Frostfire Orb". This makes it one of the few "frostfire" spells used by Mages. Notably, this talent yields two completely different effects on each rank. The first transforms the orb while the second empowers it.
Frostcrag Drums are provided as an objective to summon Jorhuttam at Jorhuttam's Feeding Mound in Highmountain Summit in Highmountain for Jorhuttam (quest).

Froststone Peak overlooks the Froststone Vault in north-central Forbidden Reach. Dominated by a large tower on the peak itself, the area is bordered by the Warder's Solace island offshore to the north, Dragonskull Island to the east, the Hornswog Grounds and Stormsunder Crater to the southeast, the Froststone Vault to the south, and the Lost Atheneum to the southwest. Atop the tower, the rare-elite vrykul Wyrmslayer Angvardi and his proto-drake Nidharr are looking down at the vault grounds. Additionally, a Dragon Glyph is inside the dome of the tower. Angvardi is also guarding the Words of the Wyrmslayer, one of the treasure criteria of Librarian of the Reach. Down in the pass, Ice Elemental

Fumblub Gearwind is a rare elite mechagnome circling the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra in his flying machine. He flies low enough for players without a flying mount to attack him and upon doing so, immediately dismounts and attacks himself. After being slain, Fumblub Gearwind can be "skinned" by players with at least 355 points in the Engineering profession. Also, players lucky enough to slay him while questing in Borean Tundra can use his body for credit towards the completion of the quest Re-Cursive or Souls of the Decursed.
Frosty Flying Carpet is a tailoring-specific crafted flying carpet mount.
Fun With Flying is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating 15 Master Tamers on Kul Tiras or Zandalar with a team of all level 25 Flying pets.

Furbolgs are a hulking, simple-minded race of bear-men who live in the northern regions of Kalimdor, in the continent of Northrend, in the Broken Isles, in the Dragon Isles, and in the Verdant Wilds island. Though they have no special love for war or murder, their tribes have become increasingly hostile as of late, many tribes have fallen to multiple forms of corruption, including but not limited to the corruptions of the Burning Legion, the Old Gods and the Primalists. Some tribes and individuals aren't hostile and are tolerant of outsiders, with tribes such as the Timbermaw, Stillpine, and Longclaw. Furious Howl is a Hunter Pet ability, specific to the Wolf class. It adds a attack power bonus to both the pet and hunter for 20 seconds. Good for a momentary DPS rise in instances. It offers the biggest DPS increase compared to other pet families, thus making wolves "mandatory" for min-maxing Hunters.
Furmund is a level 41 quest giver located in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. He is only available during the Feast of Winter Veil event.

__NOTOC__ Furious Crawdad is a rare fish caught in the mountain lakes of Terokkar Forest: Lake Jorune, Lake Ere'Noru, and Blackwind Lake. Furious Crawdad share Highland Mixed Pools with Golden Darters. These lakes are only accessible by flying.
Furies Deck is an item that begins the quest Darkmoon Furies Deck, which rewards the player with a Darkmoon Card: Vengeance.
Fur Lining - Attack Power is a leatherworking-only permanent enchant to bracers to increase attack power by 130.
__NOTOC__ Fyra Dawnstar is a blood elf leading the Scryers forces at the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley.
Fuzz is a cat that could be found perched sleeping on a nightstand near a bed in one of the rooms in the Gilded Rose in Stormwind City. Since the Shattering it's been moved to Dalaran.

G'nathus is a boss-level eel swimming offshore of the north side of Shan'ze Dao in northwestern Townlong Steppes. Some pandaren believe G'nathus to be an ancient Zandalari loa left behind to guard the waters south of Lei Shen's island citadel, while others suggest that the mogu formed the great beast in their Halls of Flesh-Shaping. A very small group thinks that G'nathus was once Lei Shen's pet fish, empowered by years of proximity to the Thunder King and flushed down into the contaminated sewers beneath the palace.
Fury of Elune is a Balance druid talent. It apparently allows druids to directly call upon the power of the night elf goddess Elune. It is an exclusive choice node with New Moon.

Fury of the Illidari is a Havoc demon hunter ability, learned from Twinblades of the Deceiver. While it was removed at the end of Legion, a similar replacement ability called Glaive Tempest was introduced during the Shadowlands expansion.
GM Execute Range is an ability used during a Pet Battle. This ability appears to be used by pets owned by Game Masters.

G.E.A.R. Tracking Beacon is a quest reward from G.E.A.R. Up. It is functionally identical to—and shares a cooldown with—the Flight Master's Whistle, except the Flight Master's Mount it summons always has the appearance of a First Squadron Prototype piloted by one of the members of G.E.A.R. (Cog Captain Winklespring, Fizzi Tinkerbow, or Emaedi Autoblast).

Galardell Valley is located in the northeastern part of the Redridge Mountains. It is the location of the infamous Tower of Ilgalar where the evil Morganth dwells. The valley is crawling with gnolls, and the most powerful of these is Lieutenant Fangore, who can dispatch an unprepared group of adventurers by calling to the nearby gnolls for help.

Ganthrifal was a nathrezim dreadlord who had been skulking about Silverpine ever since the Forsaken undead had taken the Undercity from the Scourge. The misguided Forsaken warlock Blarus Whitrick's magical experiments in the ruined castle of Gaval Moch drew the dreadlord's attention, and he spied on Blarus for some time before concluding that the foolish and naïve warlock could be a useful tool for the Burning Legion. :"He has a fondness for expensive spirits (finding the pun extremely amusing) and likes to remember Draenor's golden age." The dreadlord pretended to be summoned by one of Blarus' spells and assisted the Forsaken in his studies. With Ganthrifal's superior knowledge of sorcery,

The Gallywix Pleasure Palace is the residence of Trade Prince Jastor Gallywix, master of the Bilgewater Cartel. It was built on the summit of the relocated Forlorn Ridge in western Azshara, northeast of Talrendis Point. The Bilgewater goblins moved the mountain in order to strip mine its minerals. The palace has an ocean view, grenade golf course, a secret booze cellar, a luxury pool, and a sauna. The booze cellar is not seen in the game.

Gallywix's Villa is a large area in northwestern Bilgewater Port in Kezan. It was originally Trade Prince Maldy's manor. This is where Trade Prince Gallywix lives, or rather did live before the port was destroyed by the nearby volcano. He also has the only dock at the port available in-game. His yacht is docked there. The villa is made up of a large walled area with a path leading to his yacht or pool, an area that contains the villa proper separated from the pool by a smaller wall, and an overlook towards the ocean. Villa Mooks and Kezan Socialites can be found here, along with Neill Penny.
Galica Bravepaw is a Highmountain tauren at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

Gala Woodbridge is a Highmountain tauren sitting in a hut slightly northwest of the lower level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. She is having a conversation with Ferra Leafheart, A'te Amberfur and Mora Cliffhoof about their children.
The Galvanized Grotto is a region within the Temple of Sethraliss where the corrupted power of Sethraliss has given rise to twisted elementals, the most powerful of which is known as Galvazzt.

The Gallywix' Boys (or Gallywix's Boys) is a goblin organization working for Jastor Gallywix. They were seen briefly during the return of the Burning Legion when they were working on Megaton in Durotar and later on the Broken Shore. They would later be seen in the Undercity during the Battle for Lordaeron, on unknown business.

Gargoth is a light-skinned, red-clothed ogre living in the Lower City of Shattrath City. He is one of cooking master The Rokk's kitchen assistants, the other being Grisy Spicecrackle. He works hard chopping meat, fish, bread, and cheese to prepare meals for the Mag'har Refugees who live in nearby tents.

Gap-closer refers to an ability to travel a medium-length distance instantly or very quickly. The best known example of this is probably Blink, although other abilities such as Charge and Death Grip would apply as well. Gap-closers are particularly relevant in arena, as are other skill groups such as interrupts and dispels.

Garrison Ford was an NPC found in the Warlords of Draenor beta that supplied testers with special Garrison-related services. Ford was found only on the level 100 PvE server, where his services allowed newly created characters to immediately advance their garrisons to maximum capabilities in order to test end-game content. Ford could be found in Moonflower Valley and Frostwall Approach, just outside the Alliance and Horde Garrisons, respectively. He provided testers with the option to upgrade their garrison to the next tier, as well as granting immediate access to all followers, additional garrison supplies, the Follower XP Muffin, Ford's Stopwatch and The Big Book of Garrison Blueprints. When Ner'zhul and his clan started to practice shadow magic, Mother Om'ra was corrupted and Gara feared her. Her forlorn spirit returned to her owner's grave. When a beast master hunter pets her and shows her a Shadowberry. If one creates a Spirit Effigy, they can return it to Om'ra's grave and redeem her. However, Xan does not approve of this and takes Gara as captive. After finding a Void Lantern, one can enter the void and find a Shadowmoon Voidblade in a tree next to Elodor. Gargolmar's Shattered Hand is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Garnet Razorwing is a razorwing flying mount rare drop from Reliwik the Defiant on the Vault of Secrets floating island in southern Korthia.

.]] The Gates of Ironforge (or the Ironforge Main Gate) lead from the cold lands of Dun Morogh into the city of Ironforge proper. They are a grand sight, and are visible from far across the land. To get to the Gates of Ironforge, you can head southwest from the Commons or north up the great ramp in central Dun Morogh. During the Legion Invasions, a small Illidari camp was briefly set up here. It would occasionally come under attack by Fel Bats. Thunderbrew Specials could also be looted from here.
__NOTOC__ Gathios the Shatterer is a boss in the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley. He is a paladin and also one of the four members of the high Illidari Council.
__NOTOC__ Gatewatcher Aendor is a blood elf guard that can be found hassling a citizen near the entrance of Silvermoon City.

The Gate of Unending Cycles is the grand entrance leading from Tanaris into Uldum. The barrier which once protected Uldum made the entrance appear as a mountain side blending in with the rest of Thistleshrub Valley. The entrance overlooks the Obelisk of the Stars, while within the entrance lies the Tomb of Khartut. Pygmies watch over the area ambushing travelers to trade to the Neferset for coconuts.

Gauntlet of Flame is a subzone of Shattered Halls. It looks like the Hall of the Fathers, but in greater disrepair. After surviving waves of flaming arrows, the Shattered Hand Blood Guard or Blood Guard Porung is fought here.

cinematic.]] comic.]] The Gates of Orgrimmar (or Orgrimmar Main Gate) is quite simply the main gateway into Orgrimmar. The area leads from the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar to the Valley of Strength. During the Siege of Orgrimmar one Blind Blademaster can be found guarding the tunnel, while Aysa Cloudsinger sneaks around behind him towards the Valley of Strength. Following the Battle for Lordaeron, a sizable group of Forsaken refugees set up a camp on the upper portion of the Gates. With patch 8.1.5, a new room known as the Pathfinder's Den was added to the gates housing all the portals to various parts of the world that had previously been scattered throughout Orgrimmar. Sylvanas Windrunne
Garuu Stonetail is a Highmountain tauren ghost located in Highmountain.

Gehennas and his fellow flamewakers were extricated from the Elemental Plane by Ragnaros shortly after Thaurissan accidentally summoned the Firelord. Unlike the fire elementals, who are beings of pure flame, the flamewakers are elementals composed of flesh and blood. Gehennas resides near the bottom of the Firelord's elemental hierarchy and covets the power and station of his superiors. He is distrusted by all who serve with him, with the exception of his two loyal guards, who believe they might gain from their overseer's ascension. Gehennas uses shadow magic and guards the Rune of Mohn along with two Flamewakers.

Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome quest giver located at a small camp in Webwinder Path just southwest of Windshear Crag and in the Stonetalon Mountains. He, a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, wished to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms could help save their forests. He had it especially in for the Venture Company. He and Kaela Shadowspear have both been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having been killed by the Horde who established themselves in the area.

__NOTOC__ Gedrah is an orc stable master found in Shadowmoon Village beside his pet, Detrafila, within Shadowmoon Valley. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge.

Gear score is a numerical value based on the statistics of a player's gear. It is (supposedly) the maximum potential of a player's performance. However, it is up to the player to perform that well. In addition to item level (ilvl), the item's actual statistics or abilities may or may not be included for calculation, as determined by specific formulas or addons. Most commonly, gear scores are a metric used to evaluate the relative strength of a player's equipment as a way of determining if that player meets a given threshold to join in certain raids or groups going through an instance. The quest began with a night elf named Ranshalla, who sought to learn about the connection between the moon goddess and the wildkin. According to the spirit of the Priestess of Elune who tended to the altar during her lifetime, the gem allowed for direct communication with the goddess herself, making the artifact invaluable. Gazlowe's Greasemonkeys are a Horde team that can be encountered on Island Expeditions as well as a group that goes to Mechagon Island. They can also be found idling in the Port of Zandalar along with the other teams. The employs have a workers union called Greasemonkey Union.

Gemisath is a green dragonspawn sent from the Emerald Gardens to attend the Khural in Maruukai during the Ohn'ahran Plains storyline. Her errand is to ask the Maruuk Centaur to honor their ancient pact with the green flight by aiding them against the Primalists and helping them empower the Emerald Oathstone. She admits that she has never previously been outside the Emerald Gardens and has therefore never seen a centaur or any other mortal from outside the Dragon Isles. Gemisath gains an audience with Khanam Matra Sarest and the other khans atop the krutal. Sarest agrees to honor the pact, but the meeting is interrupted by Balakar Khan, who protests against aiding the dragons and kills Gemisa
Georgia is a Forsaken bat flight master located next to Khaelyn Steelwing at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. She provides flight paths for the members of the Horde.

__NOTOC__ General Tiras'alan is a draenei quest giver located near A'dal at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City. He reports the progress that Shattered Sun Offensive archmages have made with the three gates of Sunwell Plateau.

General Nazgrim is the eighth boss of Siege of Orgrimmar. Nazgrim fought, traveled, and brought glory to the Horde during the Northrend, Cataclysm, and Pandaria campaigns alongside fellow Horde heroes. In the end, he would place his loyalty to Warchief Garrosh Hellscream before being ended by the Alliance he fought against and the Horde heroes he fought with. The encounter with Nazgrim involves dealing with his various rage-powered abilities as a Warrior and the Kor'kron adds he summons.

According to a tale fabricated by a spirit who was none other than Teron Gorefiend, the remaining death knights knelt before him and offered their lives as a sign of loyalty, after which Teron killed every one of them. From the fallen death knights rose the Ghostriders of Karabor. After the ritual, Teron killed himself. They currently patrol the perimeter of Shadowmoon Valley, bearing Gorefiend's Truncheon. They can only be seen by equipping the Spectrecles provided for the Teron Gorefiend quest chain or the helms provided as rewards for it. __NOTOC__ Giant Egg can be looted from most level 41-60 Beast, and Humanoid monsters, particularly those that fly like Rocs. Your best source for killing these is the Savage Owlbeast in the Hinterlands. The easiest source in Tanaris for the Clamette Surprise quest are the Searing Rocs near the giant bones in Southwest Tanaris, north and northeast of Uldum. There are also Fire Rocs in Central Tanaris near Giant Bones north of Eastmoon Ruins. Most sets of Giant Bones have groups of Rocs around them.

Ghostly Human Celebrants are human spirits located at the Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. :Detect Lesser Invisibility is required in order to see this spirit, which is provided from Orange Marigold and Bouquet of Orange Marigolds.

__NOTOC__ The Giant Boar is a boar located at the Darkmaul Plains on Exile's Reach. The Alliance's second expedition to the island created it by using the Re-Sizer v9.0.1 on one of the Wandering Boars in the area. They then rode the boar to the nearby Ogre Ruins to trample an army of Zombie Servants and Monstrous Cadavers. After the undead army was destroyed, the re-sizer's effect wore off and the boar shrunk back down to its original size.

poster.]] Gillijim's Isle is an island in the South Seas off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. It is south of the Island of Doctor Lapidis. It is a jungle troll isle that is currently not in World of Warcraft, but it appears on the World of Warcraft World Map released in 2006. It also appears in the intro cinematic for World of Warcraft, on a map in The Comic and in the World of Warcraft: Game Manual. It also appeared in several maps throughout the Warcraft RPG, for example "Monster Guide Web Supplement" of 2007.

__NOTOC__ Gidge Spellweaver is a gnome spellfire tailoring vendor located in the Lower City in Shattrath City. She provides the quest for a tailor to specialize into Spellcloth, and provides the recipes for Spellcloth, Wrath of Spellfire and a large enchanting bag: Spellfire Bag.
A Gift of Adoration: Undercity is a container item obtained from non-guard NPCs in Undercity during the Love is in the Air event.
A Gift of Friendship: Undercity is a container item obtained from non-guard NPCs in Undercity during the Love is in the Air event. __NOTOC__
Gilneas City Guards are humans found throughout Gilneas City.

Gift of Chi-Ji was a pet ability available exclusively to the crane family of hunter pets, reviving a fallen party member with 60% health and 20% mana, even in combat. It was functionally identical to the quilen family's Eternal Guardian and the moth family's Dust of Life. Note, however, that none of these abilities were usable in Arena matches.
Giantcap Mushroom is a consumable sold by the Mushroom Merchant in Neltharion's Lair. On use, it increases your size and attack power for 1 minute. It is only usable in Highmountain

__NOTOC__ Ginro Hearthkindle is a night elf quest giver located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, after the Hatecrest naga invaded Feathermoon Isle. It is possible he was killed in the attack. Quintis Jonespyre had contracted a debt of Kalimdor Hold 'Em to Ginro.

Gladiators (or pitfighters) are combatants forced to fight in arenas or pits. They use morningstars, halberds and trap-nets. Many slaves and prisoners are forced into gladiatorial fights. During the early decades of the Age of Order, a sly ogre chieftain decreed that disputes in his clan would be settled via proxy in one-on-one combat between gladiator slaves. The mortality rate amongst the ogres plummeted, leading to a golden age of expansion. Two most iconic characters of Azeroth were gladiators during their enslavement, Thrall and Varian Wrynn. The Girdle of Ruination is a cloth belt that gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, spell critical chance, and overall magical power.

Ginger McGrubbins works in the Tower of Azora for her master Archmage Theocritus. Ginger does not use magic. She was originally employed as a cleaner but she swept two kinds of Magic Dusts in the same bucket. The bucket started to cast Chain Lightning and after that she was moved to the Garden.
Gimzy Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

The Glimmering Pillar is located in northern Sholazar Basin and is bordered clockwise from the north by The Savage Thicket, The Bonefields, Death's Hand Encampment, Wildgrowth Mangal, Bittertide Lake and Mistwhisper Refuge. Like the Suntouched Pillar, Skyreach Pillar and Mosslight Pillar, it is a tall, narrow butt that rises up from the relatively flat basin floor, with a thin, elongated device hovering over it, swirling with magic. It's covered with white crystals, and flower-headed Servants of Freya sit upon its flat top. During the war against the Lich King, the Cult of the Damned tried to destroy it as they did the Lifeblood Pillar, but they were stopped by the Avatar of Freya and advent

Gleep Chatterswitch is a gnome located in the Shrine of Seven Stars of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He provides transport to Ratchet via goblin Teleportation Pad during the quest A Little Field Work and starts The Road to War (Alliance). After the first quest, you can use it to go to Ratchet at anytime for per trip.
Glana Rivertreader is a Highmountain tauren located at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Glimmerfly Matriarch is a glimmerfly encountered by adventure companions in Bastion.
Glamora is a dracthyr located in Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken. She sells cosmetic gladiator gear as a reward for reaching Elite: Dragonflight Season 1 and Elite: Dragonflight Season 2.

Glittering Strand a beach area south of Moonrest Gardens in southwest Dragonblight. The area is covered in blue dragonflight forces. A Ley Line Focus can also be found here; the place is led by Emmy Malin, a captain of the Mage Hunters.
Glory of the Dragonflight Hero is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by completing all the Dragonflight Mythic dungeon achievements.

Glyphs are items that can change a spell or ability's visual appearance. Most glyphs are crafted by scribes, are color-coded by class, and can be applied as early as level 11. They can be removed at any time outside of combat using Vanishing Powder. To apply a glyph, right-click it in your inventory to use it. This will automatically open the spellbook, where the target spell will light up. Click the lit-up spell to apply the glyph. An ability that has a glyph applied to it will be marked in the spellbook with a pink mark on its corner.

Glyph of Arcane Power is a major glyph for mages. When a mage's Arcane Power (Classic) spell is active, the global cooldown of the mage's Blink, Mana Shield (Classic), and Mirror Image spells is reduced to zero.
Glowfly Bottle is provided as an objective for A Magical Glow.
Glyph of Confession teaches the ability Confession (priest ability).
Glyph of Fireworks teaches the ability Fireworks (hunter ability).

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Glyph of Purification |icon=BTNGlyph |desc=Created by ancient druids, this glyph has the power to heal the land. |bind=BoP |disambigpage=Glyph of Purification (Warcraft III) }} The Glyph of Purification was created by ancient druids. The glyph had the power to heal the land and was held by the Khan of the Stonetalon centaurs. Thrall and Cairne Bloodhoof killed the centaur khan and his group in order to get the glyph and purify the Defiled Fountain.
This Glyph modifies the Druid Typhoon ability. In addition to the tooltip listed effects, it increases range of the ability by 10 yards.
This glyph modifies the cooldown of the Warrior's Shockwave ability (an ability granted by a protection tree talent). The default cooldown on Shockwave is 20 seconds.

Glyph of the Aquatic Chameleonis a glyph for the druid ability Aquatic Form. It randomly selects one of your unlocked Aquatic Form appearances each time the ability is activated. Aquatic Form appearances include the default form, the Dolphin, the Tideskipper Dolphin, and the Orca.

Glyph of the Swift Chameleon is a glyph for the druid ability Travel Form. It randomly selects one of your unlocked land-based Travel Form appearances each time the ability's land variant is activated. Travel Form appearances include the default form, the Cheetah, and the Doe.

Gnomus is a gnome quest giver located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley. He is the creator of Arcano-Scorp and mentioned in some Horde quests too. Once a genius, he later became mad and wants to eat some of the fel beasts in Shadowmoon Valley.
Gnaw is one of the abilities that is available to the Unholy Death Knight Ghoul pet. It deals 12% of the ghoul's attack power modified weapon damage. It is affected by Dark Transformation.
Gnomeregan Flying Machine is a flying machine found outside of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh during the Operation: Gnomeregan event.

Go'rath is a servant of the Old Gods. Within the Maw of Go'rath, the faceless general Warlord Zon'ozz commands the power of this ancient creature against the defenders of Wyrmrest. Go'rath ceases to attack once Warlord Zon'ozz has been slain. During the Fourth War, champions can sometimes find a portal on any of the island expeditions that leads to Go'rath. Within the Maw of Gorath, General Shuul'aqar can be found.

Gnome Wing Commander are gnomes that appear during certain quests while using the Goblin Heavy Guns at Krom'gar Fortress. They pilot Gnomish Flying Machines and Bombers. When the flying machines are shot down, they will parachute out and be vulnerable to gunfire. One shot from the Goblin Heavy Gun will kill them.
Go-Getter is awarded for completing the The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Powermonger within 25 tolls, the first in a series of four.
Goal-Oriented is awarded for completing The Real Big Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Powermonger within 40 tolls.

Gnomeregan Tinkerers are militarized gnome tinkers from Gnomeregan that briefly appear in Stormwind City and are later seen following Gelbin Mekkatorque during The Battle for Broken Shore (Alliance). After the battle, some of them are seen wounded aboard the Skyfire, being treated by Stormwind Priests and Gilnean Druids.

Gol'dir is an orc quest giver formerly located upstairs in the Strahnbrad inn in the Alterac Mountains. He is the leader of a group of orcs, Drull, Krusk and Tog'thar, sent by Thrall to investigate the Syndicate presence in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Captured by the Syndicate, he was initially held at a large Syndicate camp to the north of Tarren Mill, before being moved to the Syndicate base in Strahnbrad. Gol'dir was later rescued by an unknown Horde agent, who also assassinated Lord Aliden Perenolde and recovered the necklace that belonged to Taretha Foxton. After his rescue, he now stands beside a flight master in Strahnbrad. He no longer gives quests.
Gold Plated Cage Head Key drops from the Death Metal Knight of the Blight Boar event on Darkmoon Island.
Goblin Flying Machines are flying machines located in Nazj'vel in Darkshore during the stalemate phase of the War of the Thorns.
The Golden Iron Destroyer is a crafted mace, quite powerful for twinks.

Goldrinn, also known as Lo'Gosh ("Ghost Wolf" in Taur-ahe), is a Wild God who takes the form of a monstrously powerful white wolf. He embodies ferocity, savagery, and an unyielding will, and legends tell that he possesses unparalleled rage and fury. His is the spirit of the hunter, the animal instinct that kicks in when wild things smell food or feel their children are in jeopardy.

Gong-Lu, Strength of Xuen is one of Wrathion's legendary cloak quest rewards for completing A Pandaren Legend in patch 5.4. It is the upgraded version of Tigerclaw Cape, created by using the Timeless Essence of the Black Dragonflight. Using the timeless essence will automatically upgrade the cloak to item level 136.
